engine_metadata.name: Nova Math Extension
engine_metadata.author: Nova Developer
engine_metadata.description: Adds arithmetic and randomization powers to the Nova Engine.

math:add.description: Adds two values. Values can be raw numbers or keys from the Drum.

math:random.description: Generates a random whole number between min and max.

math:round.description: Rounds the decimal number stored in the key to the nearest integer.

math:absolute.description: Returns the positive version of a number (Absolute Value).
